_comment: Full-state digests (Simulation.state_digest) for simulation contract 2. Keys are '<sys.platform>-<machine>' because trajectories can differ across platforms (math library differences). A missing key skips the test and reports the digest; record one with `python tests/record_golden.py --write`. Changing an existing value is a simulation-contract change and must be explained in CHANGELOG.md. Contract 1 digests are reproducible from tag v0.1.1-alpha.
